title: 污水化學除磷~Chemical phosphorus removal from wastewater
focus: 金屬鹽化學計量、膠體分離與新增污泥~Metal-salt stoichiometry, colloid separation and added sludge
summary: 本課以金屬鹽化學計量、膠體分離與新增污泥為主線，從除磷目標與成分、元素莫耳配比、活性成分日量、藥液濃度與密度進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops metal-salt stoichiometry, colloid separation and added sludge through ten connected units, beginning with phosphorus target and fractions, elemental molar ratio, daily active-component mass, solution fraction and density. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 除磷目標與成分~Phosphorus target and fractions
units.mechanism: 先界定需移除的是溶解正磷酸鹽還是顆粒磷，避免把過濾問題當缺藥。~Define dissolved versus particulate removal before mistaking filtration failure for chemical shortage.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=2500 m³/d；TP=6 mg P/L。模型 LP=QCP/1000，代入得到 15 kg P/d。適用邊界：TP 與溶解性磷須分開；流量加權後再計算。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=2500 m³/d; TP=6 mg P/L. Model LP=QCP/1000 gives 15 kg P/d. Applicability: Separate total and dissolved phosphorus; use flow weighting.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「除磷目標與成分」的觀測點。對照總磷消化分析與過濾樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for phosphorus target and fractions. Compare digested total-P analysis with filtered samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 總磷高但溶解磷低可能是固體流失。診斷與介入：重測總磷與溶解磷，將固體分離和水相反應分開診斷。~High TP with low dissolved P can indicate solids escape. Diagnostic response: Remeasure total/dissolved P and diagnose solids separation separately from aqueous reactions.
units.misconception: 所有出水磷都可只靠加藥解決。~Every phosphorus problem is solved by dosing more chemical.
units.practice: 只改變 TP:6→8 mg P/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 15 變為 20 kg P/d。用「除磷目標與成分」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only TP:6→8 mg P/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 15 to 20 kg P/d. Explain the direction using phosphorus target and fractions, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 元素莫耳配比~Elemental molar ratio
units.mechanism: 沉澱化學計量以莫耳而非藥液公斤計；實際共沉澱偏離理想比。~Precipitation stoichiometry uses moles, not kilograms of solution; real co-precipitation differs from ideal ratios.
units.model: 原創教學假設：P=10 kg/d；假設 Fe/P=1.5 mol/mol；原子量 Fe=55.85、P=30.97。模型 Fe=P r×55.85/30.97，代入得到 27.050371 kg Fe/d。適用邊界：是假想元素鐵需求，不是商用藥劑投加量；共沉澱與副反應需瓶杯試驗。~Original teaching assumptions: P=10 kg/d; assumed Fe/P=1.5 mol/mol; atomic masses Fe=55.85, P=30.97. Model Fe=P r×55.85/30.97 gives 27.050371 kg Fe/d. Applicability: Hypothetical elemental-Fe demand, not a commercial reagent dose; co-precipitation and side reactions require jar testing.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「元素莫耳配比」的觀測點。核對原子量、藥劑活性成分與瓶杯試驗的溶解磷。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for elemental molar ratio. Check atomic masses, reagent active content and dissolved P from jar tests. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 用 FeCl3 質量直接當元素鐵質量。診斷與介入：校對元素莫耳與藥品成分，再用平行瓶杯驗證。~FeCl3 mass is incorrectly treated as elemental Fe. Diagnostic response: Check elemental moles and reagent composition, then use parallel jar tests.
units.misconception: 鐵磷莫耳比等於質量比。~Fe/P molar ratio equals mass ratio.
units.practice: 只改變 r:1.5→2.0 mol/mol，其餘假設固定；結果應由 27.050371 變為 36.067162 kg Fe/d。用「元素莫耳配比」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only r:1.5→2.0 mol/mol, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 27.050371 to 36.067162 kg Fe/d. Explain the direction using elemental molar ratio, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 活性成分日量~Daily active-component mass
units.mechanism: 把假設劑量乘流量得到活性量，負荷變化時不可只固定泵頻率。~Multiply assumed dose by flow for active mass; changing load cannot be handled by pump frequency alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；假設活性成分 D=5 mg/L。模型 M=QD/1000，代入得到 10 kg active/d。適用邊界：僅單位換算示例，不是推薦劑量；藥液濃度須另換算。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; assumed active-component dose D=5 mg/L. Model M=QD/1000 gives 10 kg active/d. Applicability: Unit-conversion example only, not a recommended dose; solution concentration requires separate conversion.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「活性成分日量」的觀測點。以藥液消耗稱重與處理水量交叉核對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for daily active-component mass. Cross-check weighed reagent consumption against treated flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 泵耗液量沒有換算活性成分。診斷與介入：核對活性成分、流量和投加量換算，避免把示例作為推薦設定。~Solution consumption is not converted to active chemical. Diagnostic response: Check active strength, flow and dosing conversion; do not use the example as a recommended setting.
units.misconception: 固定泵頻率就保證固定 mg/L。~Fixed pump speed guarantees fixed mg/L.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:2000→2500 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 10 變為 12.5 kg active/d。用「活性成分日量」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:2000→2500 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 10 to 12.5 kg active/d. Explain the direction using daily active-component mass, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 藥液濃度與密度~Solution fraction and density
units.mechanism: 藥液體積取決於活性分率及密度，標籤基準須逐一核對。~Solution volume depends on active fraction and density; verify label bases.
units.model: 原創教學假設：活性藥劑=10 kg/d；質量分率=0.20；密度=1.2 kg/L。模型 Vsol=M/(wρ)，代入得到 41.666667 L/d。適用邊界：確認標示為質量分率而非體積分率；密度受溫度影響。~Original teaching assumptions: Active chemical=10 kg/d; mass fraction=0.20; density=1.2 kg/L. Model Vsol=M/(wρ) gives 41.666667 L/d. Applicability: Confirm mass rather than volume fraction; density depends on temperature.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「藥液濃度與密度」的觀測點。核對供應商分析證明與實測密度、泵標定。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for solution fraction and density. Check certificate of analysis, measured density and pump calibration. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把百分濃度當作無單位的整數。診斷與介入：重新確認濃度標示、密度與計量泵實測出量。~Using percent as a whole-number fraction gives a large error. Diagnostic response: Reconfirm concentration labeling, density and measured pump delivery.
units.misconception: 20% 藥液可直接用數字 20 計算。~Use 20 directly for a 20% solution.
units.practice: 只改變 w:0.20→0.25，其餘假設固定；結果應由 41.666667 變為 33.333333 L/d。用「藥液濃度與密度」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only w:0.20→0.25, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 41.666667 to 33.333333 L/d. Explain the direction using solution fraction and density, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 快速分散與均勻性~Rapid distribution and uniformity
units.mechanism: 反應初期需充分分散，局部過濃可能造成耗藥與不均勻絮體。~Early reagent distribution matters; local excess wastes chemical and creates uneven floc.
units.model: 原創教學假設：P=100 W；μ=0.001 Pa·s；V=10 m³。模型 G=sqrt(P/(μV))，代入得到 100 s⁻¹。適用邊界：耗散功率平均值，不等於馬達銘牌功率或局部剪切。~Original teaching assumptions: P=100 W; viscosity=0.001 Pa·s; V=10 m³. Model G=sqrt(P/(μV)) gives 100 s⁻¹. Applicability: Mean dissipated power, not nameplate motor power or local shear.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「快速分散與均勻性」的觀測點。校正軸功率、黏度與有效槽容，觀察局部絮體破碎。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for rapid distribution and uniformity. Check shaft power, viscosity and effective volume and observe local floc breakage. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 攪拌器有轉動不代表混合均勻。診斷與介入：查實際傳入水中功率、黏度與死角，觀察絮體而非只看電表。~A rotating mixer does not prove uniform mixing. Diagnostic response: Check power delivered to water, viscosity and dead zones, observing flocs rather than electricity alone.
units.misconception: 攪拌功率越大一定越好。~More mixing power is always better.
units.practice: 只改變 P:100→64 W，其餘假設固定；結果應由 100 變為 80 s⁻¹。用「快速分散與均勻性」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only P:100→64 W, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 100 to 80 s⁻¹. Explain the direction using rapid distribution and uniformity, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 膠凝接觸~Flocculation exposure
units.mechanism: 膠凝讓微小沉澱形成可分離絮體，過剪切會再次破碎。~Flocculation aggregates fine precipitates; excessive shear breaks them again.
units.model: 原創教學假設：G=40 s⁻¹；t=1200 s。模型 Gt=G×t，代入得到 48000 dimensionless。適用邊界：平均剪切指標，不含局部過度剪切與絮體破碎；非單獨驗收標準。~Original teaching assumptions: G=40 s⁻¹; t=1200 s. Model Gt=G×t gives 48000 dimensionless. Applicability: Mean shear exposure, excluding local overshear and floc breakage; not a sole acceptance criterion.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「膠凝接觸」的觀測點。觀察絮體尺寸、沉降性與攪拌功率。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for flocculation exposure. Observe floc size, settleability and mixing power. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只延長時間而忽略局部剪切。診斷與介入：同時比較絮體破碎、沉降和殘濁，離線修正混合分段。~Longer time alone ignores local shear. Diagnostic response: Compare breakup, settling and residual turbidity while revising mixing stages offline.
units.misconception: Gt 相同就有完全相同絮體。~Identical Gt produces identical floc.
units.practice: 只改變 t:1200→900 s，其餘假設固定；結果應由 48000 變為 36000 dimensionless。用「膠凝接觸」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only t:1200→900 s, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 48000 to 36000 dimensionless. Explain the direction using flocculation exposure, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 瓶杯試驗與空白~Jar testing and controls
units.mechanism: 同批原水設空白與平行杯，將 pH、劑量與攪拌分開比較。~Use blanks and replicates on one raw-water batch and separate pH, dose and mixing changes.
units.model: 原創教學假設：原水濁度=50 NTU；沉降後=5 NTU。模型 ηT=(T0-T)/T0，代入得到 0.9 fraction。適用邊界：濁度指標不是污染物質量或病原去除率。~Original teaching assumptions: Raw turbidity=50 NTU; settled turbidity=5 NTU. Model ηT=(T0-T)/T0 gives 0.9 fraction. Applicability: Turbidity reduction is not contaminant mass or pathogen removal.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「瓶杯試驗與空白」的觀測點。所有杯使用相同攪拌、沉降時間並同時量 pH。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for jar testing and controls. Use matching mixing/settling times across jars and measure pH. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 同時改三參數無法辨識主要原因。診斷與介入：重做同批原水平行試驗，分開藥量、剪切與時間的影響。~Changing three variables together hides causality. Diagnostic response: Repeat parallel tests on one water batch, separating dose, shear and time effects.
units.misconception: 單杯最低濁度可直接當永久最佳劑量。~One lowest-turbidity jar gives a permanent optimum dose.
units.practice: 只改變 T:5→8 NTU，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.9 變為 0.84 fraction。用「瓶杯試驗與空白」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only T:5→8 NTU, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.9 to 0.84 fraction. Explain the direction using jar testing and controls, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 固體分離負荷~Separation loading
units.mechanism: 化學沉澱增加固體量，沉澱池水力與固體能力都要同步檢查。~Chemical precipitation adds solids; check both hydraulic and solids separation capacities.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=3000 m³/d；A=120 m²。模型 SOR=Q/A，代入得到 25 m/d。適用邊界：表面溢流率只是一個水力指標，不能單獨決定絮凝沉降效率。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=3000 m³/d; A=120 m². Model SOR=Q/A gives 25 m/d. Applicability: Surface overflow rate is a hydraulic metric, not a complete predictor of flocculent settling.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「固體分離負荷」的觀測點。將流量、池面積與沉降柱結果一起比較。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for separation loading. Compare flow and plan area with settling-column observations. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 加藥有效卻因絮體外流仍有高總磷。診斷與介入：比較分池流量及沉降測試，先評估配流是否失衡。~Successful precipitation can still leave high TP through floc escape. Diagnostic response: Compare cell flows and settling tests, first checking distribution imbalance.
units.misconception: 化學反應完成就不需要沉澱分離。~Completed reaction eliminates the need for solids separation.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:3000→4200 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 25 變為 35 m/d。用「固體分離負荷」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:3000→4200 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 25 to 35 m/d. Explain the direction using separation loading, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 污泥及含磷出口~Sludge and phosphorus export
units.mechanism: 新增化學污泥影響脫水、運輸與後續處理，必須納入完整方案。~Added chemical sludge affects dewatering, transport and downstream handling.
units.model: 原創教學假設：乾固體排泥=150 kg/d；污泥 P 質量分率=0.04。模型 Pout=MDS fP，代入得到 6 kg P/d。適用邊界：均勻代表樣本與乾基含磷率；濕污泥重量不能直接代入。~Original teaching assumptions: Dry solids wasted=150 kg/d; sludge P fraction=0.04. Model Pout=MDS fP gives 6 kg P/d. Applicability: Representative sampling and dry-basis P fraction; wet sludge mass cannot be substituted.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「污泥及含磷出口」的觀測點。稱重乾固體後分析 P，與水線進出量閉合。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge and phosphorus export. Measure dry mass and P content and close the balance against the water line. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只比較藥費而忽略污泥成本與質量。診斷與介入：重算乾固體與乾基含磷率，將濕重和元素質量分開。~Comparing reagent cost alone omits sludge burdens. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry solids and dry-basis P content separately from wet mass.
units.misconception: 藥劑除磷不會增加固體處理需求。~Chemical P removal never increases solids handling.
units.practice: 只改變 MDS:150→180 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 6 變為 7.2 kg P/d。用「污泥及含磷出口」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only MDS:150→180 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 6 to 7.2 kg P/d. Explain the direction using sludge and phosphorus export, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 閉合與殘餘金屬~Closure and residual metal
units.mechanism: 以磷收支與殘餘金屬分析判讀效果，不將提高投量視為唯一解方。~Assess P balance and residual metal instead of treating dose escalation as the only remedy.
units.model: 原創教學假設：進入=15、出流水=2、排泥=12 kg/d。模型 ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge，代入得到 1 kg/d。適用邊界：殘差可能來自儲存、漏算旁流與量測誤差，不能自動當作反應。~Original teaching assumptions: Input=15, effluent=2, sludge=12 kg/d. Model ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge gives 1 kg/d. Applicability: Residual can reflect storage, omitted side streams or measurement error, not automatically a reaction.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「閉合與殘餘金屬」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for closure and residual metal. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: pH 改變與殘餘金屬被漏列。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。~pH shifts and residual metal are omitted. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.
units.misconception: 出水磷下降代表所有品質均改善。~Lower effluent P means every quality parameter improves.
units.practice: 只改變 Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1 變為 0.5 kg/d。用「閉合與殘餘金屬」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1 to 0.5 kg/d. Explain the direction using closure and residual metal, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
